response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan AS timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan), scored AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_mean, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_mean AS excess_over_timespan_avg, rnk AS rank_in_timespan FROM scored WHERE avg_fill > tif_mean AND rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark
